limitations: Fixed convex polygons under invariant Crofton cutting lines; neither a complete mass distribution nor a joint polygon-to-disk crossover. Sharp upper bound applies only to parallelograms. The 2011 predecessor full text remained inaccessible.
scientific_integrity: Exact asymptotic and strict extremal proofs. Finite numerical checks are supplementary; no independent historical priority or mathematical audit is claimed.
title: Sharp Crofton dust coefficient for convex polygons and its parallelogram extremum
